svg.title: MiloBroker ? illustrative owner WhatsApp conversation
svg.desc: A static sample chat. An owner posts an east-facing, semi-furnished 2 BHK house with a modular kitchen near Indiranagar metro station for Rs.42,000 per month. Two illustrative attachments show a living room and kitchen. MiloBroker confirms that the property was successfully posted. This is not a live listing or chat. No photos are uploaded and no property is actually posted; the conversation and composer are display-only.

text.tspan: Hi! I own a 2 BHK house.
It is east facing, semi furnished,
